# Desk UI

Script forms and lists, call the server from JavaScript, and build desk pages and navigation.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Form Scripts](form-scripts.md) | Add client-side behavior to a desk form with frappe.ui.form.on events, the frm object API and the doctype_js hook. |
| [List View Settings](list-view-settings.md) | Customize the desk list, tree, calendar, gantt and kanban views of a DocType with <doctype>_list.js and the related view settings files and hooks. |
| [Client API](client-api.md) | Call the server, read data, show messages and dialogs, route, and format values from desk JavaScript with frappe.call, frappe.db, frappe.model, frappe.ui.Dialog and related helpers. |
| [Desk Pages](desk-pages.md) | Build a custom desk screen with the Page DocType, its JSON, JS, CSS and HTML files, frappe.pages events and frappe.ui.make_app_page. |
| [Workspaces, Sidebar and Dock](workspaces-sidebar-dock.md) | Ship desk navigation from an app with Workspace, Sidebar and Dock JSON records and the add_to_apps_screen hook. |
| [Islands](islands.md) | Draw desk pages and widgets with Vue islands, self-contained bundles that the desk mounts in a shadow root by name. |
